comments.author: Laserpulse
comments.body_html: A small nitpick, but the plugins folder in the zip uses an upper-case P instead of a lower-case one. I know not a lot of people play on Linux, but it is a case-sensitive OS, so dragging the BepInEx folder into the SPT folder produces a new Plugins (upper-case) folder and does not merge into the plugins (lower-case) folder. If a user isn’t careful they could end up with two plugins folders and not realise it, causing errors.
